name: flowsync
description: FlowSync — real-time team collaboration platform (Next.js + Express + Socket.IO + MongoDB + Redis)

scripts.dev:backend: echo "backend not yet implemented — see Step 2" && exit 1
scripts.build:backend: f=$(find backend/src -name '*.ts'); if [ -z "$f" ]; then echo 'backend: no source files yet — see Step 2'; else tsc $f --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution node --lib ES2022 --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --forceConsistentCasingInFileNames --resolveJsonModule --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --outDir backend/dist --rootDir backend/src --sourceMap; fi
scripts.typecheck:backend: f=$(find backend/src -name '*.ts'); if [ -z "$f" ]; then echo 'backend: no source files yet — see Step 2'; else tsc $f --noEmit --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution node --lib ES2022 --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --forceConsistentCasingInFileNames --resolveJsonModule --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --rootDir backend/src; fi
